Faculty of Fashion and Interior Designing - RKDF University Ranchi, Jharkhand, India 834004
Faculty of Fashion and Interior Designing
RKDF University, Ranchi
Faculty of Fashion and Interior Designing
Fashion design is a form of art dedicated to the creation of clothing and other lifestyle accessories. Modern fashion design is divided into two basic categories: haute couture and ready-to-wear. The haute couture collection is dedicated to certain customers and is custom sized to fit these customers exactly.To work as a designer, you should have an artistic and creative personality. You also have to be good at drawing and able to express your ideas in sketches. You don’t necessarily have to be a great artist, but you must have some special skills for combining colors, tones and shades. You also have to be able to work with fabric and use textiles in a creative and original manner. Fashion designers have a good visual imagination and are able to think in three-dimensions and put their ideas into garments.Fashion designers have to be aware of the fashion market requirements. They have to be very interested in learning new things and read magazines, journals and books on fashion design history and new trends. They also have to be interested in art, visit art galleries and interact with all kinds of artists whenever they have the opportunity.Interior design is all about how we experience spaces. It’s a powerful, essential part of our daily lives and affects how we live, work, play, and even heal. Comfortable homes, functional workplaces, beautiful public spaces—that’s interior design at work. Designers craft spaces that anticipate our needs and appeal to our emotions while pulling from a broad set of skills and technical knowledge. Interior design has changed dramatically since the early 20th century when it was just beginning to emerge as a profession. Today, interior designers work with contractors, architects, engineers, craftsmen, furniture dealers, and business and home owners. To become a successful interior designer, you need a well-rounded education and the skills to work within many disciplines (architecture; graphic design; decorative arts; and textile, furniture, and lighting design).

Journalism and Mass Communication is a field of study and practice that focuses on gathering, producing, and disseminating information and content through various forms of media to inform, educate, entertain, and influence the public. content developers.Journalism and Mass Communication is essential in shaping public opinion, fostering social awareness, and driving cultural exchange in the rapidly evolving global media landscape. To achieve this goal, the curriculum has been structured so that students may put their theoretical knowledge into practice right here at the Department of Journalism & Mass Communication at RKDF University Ranchi, giving them the hands-on experience they need to become effective media professionals.

Faculty of Library Science
RKDF University, Ranchi
Faculty of Library Science
Library Science, also known as Library and Information Science (LIS), is an interdisciplinary field of study that focuses on the management, organization, and dissemination of information resources. It encompasses the principles, practices, and technologies used in collecting, organizing, preserving, and providing access to information in various formats, including books, journals, digital media, and databases.Key areas of library science include:Cataloging and Classification: Organizing information and resources so they can be easily located and accessed.Information Retrieval: Developing systems and techniques for finding and retrieving information efficiently.Preservation and Archiving: Protecting and maintaining physical and digital materials for future use.Library Management: Overseeing the operations of libraries, including budgeting, staffing, and policy development.User Services: Assisting individuals in accessing and using library resources effectively.Digital Libraries: Creating and managing digital repositories of information and facilitating online access.Information Ethics: Addressing issues such as copyright, intellectual property, and the ethical use of information.Professionals in library science, known as librarians, often work in public libraries, academic institutions, research centers, and specialized libraries. With the rapid advancement of technology, the field has expanded to include digital information management, making it a crucial discipline in today’s information-driven world.Department of  Library Science at RKDF University, Ranchi concentrates on providing quality education in a highly disciplined environment and would like to position itself as a centre of excellence for study of Library Sciences.

Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences

Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences
Pharmacy is a scientific discipline focused on discovering, producing, preparing, dispensing, and reviewing drugs to ensure their safe, effective, and affordable use. Individuals who complete their studies in this field are called pharmacists. Various types of pharmacy exist, including Community Pharmacy, Hospital Pharmacy, Clinical Pharmacy, Industrial Pharmacy, Compounding Pharmacy, Consulting Pharmacy, Ambulatory Care Pharmacy, Regulatory Pharmacy, and Homecare Pharmacy. Pharmacy technicians play a vital role in supporting pharmacists and other healthcare professionals by performing tasks such as dispensing prescription drugs, providing medical devices to patients, and offering guidance on their proper use.Pharmaceutical Science is a dynamic and evolving field that integrates a wide range of scientific disciplines essential for the discovery and development of new drugs and therapies. This sector plays a pivotal role in advancing global health and well-being. A qualification in Pharmaceutical Science can open doors to diverse career opportunities, often providing pathways for growth in research, management, and allied health sciences.Over the past six years, RKDF University Ranchi has strived to achieve high standards of academic excellence, particularly in research, innovation, and incubation. The university’s efforts in supplying skilled and specialized human resources to the healthcare sector are widely acknowledged and appreciated.
